description: SSRF-safe outbound HTTP for .NET: public addresses only (checked after resolution, DNS rebinding included), every redirect revalidated, bounded time and size, IHttpClientFactory integration. NativeAOT-ready.
rules: Register with services.AddMyelin(o => ...) and inject SafeHttpClient, or add .UseMyelin() to an AddHttpClient registration.
Never fetch a user-supplied URL with a plain HttpClient: use SafeHttpClient or a UseMyelin() client.
A refusal throws OutboundRefusedException with Reason (RefusalReasons constants) and Host; 4xx/5xx statuses are returned, not thrown.
SafeHttpClient.GetAsync follows and revalidates redirects; PostJsonAsync and SendOnceAsync never follow one; UseMyelin() clients return redirects to the caller.
Replace IHostResolver to make tests deterministic; never disable the address checks.
